stories.title: Generate Lab Environment Provisioning Scripts for All CoCu Hardware Units
stories.description: Create Docker Compose and VirtualBox configuration templates for each CoCu's hardware/software environment, enabling students to provision identical lab setups locally. Scripts should validate hardware requirements (CPU cores, RAM, disk) and auto-detect Windows vs Linux host.
acceptanceCriteria: Generate output/lab-provisioning/{cocu-name}/docker-compose.yml for each CoCu with service definitions matching tools/equipment list
Generate output/lab-provisioning/{cocu-name}/Vagrantfile with box, provisioning shell script, and port mappings for all required services
Script scripts/generate_lab_configs.py accepts --cocu-id, --platform (docker|vagrant) and produces validation report checking CPU/RAM/disk against content/IT-020-*/tools* specifications

stories.title: Validate Learning Outcome Coverage Across All 20 CoCu Files
stories.description: Audit that every learning outcome in each CoCu has at least one corresponding practical exercise or assessment task. Generate report showing coverage percentage and identify orphaned outcomes requiring additional activities.
acceptanceCriteria: Script scripts/validate_outcome_coverage.py parses all content/IT-020-*/*.md files, extracts learning outcomes, matches against exercises/assessments in same CoCu
Outputs coverage report to output/learning-outcome-coverage.json with format: {cocu_id, total_outcomes, covered_count, coverage_percent, orphaned_outcomes: [{outcome_text, section}]}
Exit code 0 if all outcomes covered, 1 if < 95% coverage (with detailed report of gaps)

stories.title: Generate Interactive Knowledge Check Quizzes for Each CoCu
stories.description: Create HTML5 quiz files (one per CoCu) with 10-15 knowledge check questions covering each section. Include immediate feedback, scoring, and optional auto-remediation hints linking back to relevant content sections.
acceptanceCriteria: Script scripts/generate_quizzes.py reads content/IT-020-*/learning-outcomes.md, generates output/quizzes/{cocu-id}-quiz.html with questions marked by Bloom's level (Remember/Understand/Apply)
Each question includes: stem, 4-5 options (1 correct), explanation, and reference link to content section (e.g., 'See Content Section 2.3: Hardware Components')
Quiz interface provides immediate feedback with correct answer + explanation, cumulative score display, and pass threshold (70%)

stories.title: Create Peer Assessment Rubrics Aligned to Competency Levels
stories.description: Generate 4-level peer assessment rubrics (Developing/Proficient/Advanced/Expert) for each key competency across all CoCu files. Rubrics include observable criteria, evidence types, and feedback templates for peer reviewers.
acceptanceCriteria: Script scripts/generate_peer_rubrics.py extracts competencies from content/IT-020-*/assessment-criteria*, generates output/peer-rubrics.xlsx with sheets per CoCu
Each rubric row: competency name, 4 proficiency levels (Developing/Proficient/Advanced/Expert), 2-3 observable behaviors per level, evidence types (e.g., 'code review', 'lab report', 'demo')
Includes feedback template phrases (e.g., 'You demonstrated understanding of X by...' / 'Next step: consider improving Y by...')

stories.title: Generate Competency Verification Checklists for Instructor Sign-Off
stories.description: Create per-CoCu instructor checklists for competency verification, including observable evidence requirements, sign-off authority, and record-keeping templates aligned to JPK audit requirements.
acceptanceCriteria: Script scripts/generate_verification_checklists.py creates output/instructor-checklists/{cocu-id}-verification.xlsx with columns: competency, evidence required, proof method (observation/assignment/exam), instructor name, date, signature field
Includes JPK compliance markers (e.g., 'Evidence must be retained per JPK Section 4.2 for 3 years') and contact hour logging (e.g., 'Log hours in SAM portal: <link>')
Validates that all 20 CoCu files have corresponding checklist sheets

stories.title: Generate Adaptive Learning Path Recommendations Based on Assessment Mastery
stories.description: Create an algorithm that analyzes learner assessment scores and recommends next learning activities. Generate sample learner profile JSON and JavaScript recommendation engine for instructor dashboards.
acceptanceCriteria: Script scripts/generate_adaptive_paths.py accepts learner-profile.json (competency scores 0-100, completion dates) and outputs recommended-activities.json with next 3 activities ranked by readiness
Recommendation logic: if mastery >= 80%, recommend next CoCu unit or advanced challenge; if 50-79%, recommend review + practice exercises; if < 50%, recommend prerequisite micro-modules
Output includes rationale for each recommendation (e.g., 'Prerequisite SQL Unit not yet mastered - recommend SQL basics module before Data Management CoCu')

stories.title: Validate Accessibility Compliance (WCAG 2.1 AA) for All Generated DOCX Files
stories.description: Audit all generated DOCX files (output/NOSS-IT-020-*.docx) for accessibility issues: missing alt text on images, improper heading hierarchy, insufficient color contrast, untagged tables. Generate compliance report with remediation guidance.
acceptanceCriteria: Script scripts/validate_docx_accessibility.py reads output/NOSS-IT-020-*.docx, checks: all images have alt text (>= 10 words), headings follow hierarchy (no h2->h4 jump), tables have header rows, links have descriptive text (not 'click here')
Outputs report: output/accessibility-audit.json with format: {docx_file, wcag_level, issues: [{issue_type, location, severity, remediation_hint}], compliance_percent}
Exit code 0 if all files >= WCAG AA (>= 95% compliance), 1 otherwise; produces output/accessibility-fixes.md with specific remediation steps per file

stories.title: Generate Industry Standards Mapping Document (SIRIM/BNM/ISCO-08)
stories.description: Create comprehensive mapping document showing how each CoCu learning outcome aligns to Malaysian industry standards (SIRIM technical standards, BNM compliance frameworks, ISCO-08 job classifications). Include employer relevance documentation.
acceptanceCriteria: Script scripts/generate_standards_mapping.py creates output/industry-standards-mapping.xlsx with columns: CoCu ID, learning outcome, SIRIM standard (if applicable), BNM requirement (if applicable), ISCO-08 code, relevance statement
Includes data sources: SIRIM standard names/URLs, BNM reference document links, ISCO-08 code descriptions (from file content/ISCO-08-mapping.json if available)
Each mapping includes employer relevance statement (e.g., 'This outcome aligns to ISCO-08 2511.01 (Systems Analysts) core requirement: system architecture understanding')

stories.title: Create Microlearning Module Generator for Key Competencies
stories.description: Generate 5-10 minute bite-sized learning modules (HTML + embedded video placeholders) for each core competency. Each module includes learning objective, key concept animation storyboards, and quick knowledge check.
acceptanceCriteria: Script scripts/generate_microlearning_modules.py creates output/microlearning/{cocu-id}/{competency-slug}.html for each competency extracted from content/IT-020-*/assessment-criteria*

Each module file includes: learning objective (1 sentence), 3-4 key concept sections (200-300 words each), embedded {{VIDEO_PLACEHOLDER}} markers with suggested video title, 3-5 question knowledge check with immediate feedback
Modules are responsive mobile-first HTML5, self-contained (no external CSS except data URIs), under 200KB each

stories.title: Generate Video Script Templates for All CoCu Content Delivery
stories.description: Create instructor-friendly video script templates (one per CoCu section) with timing cues, visual direction notes, and key talking points. Scripts enable consistent video production quality across all 20 CoCu files.
acceptanceCriteria: Script scripts/generate_video_scripts.py reads content/IT-020-*/*.md, extracts top-level sections (##), generates output/video-scripts/{cocu-id}-section-{num}.md per section

Each script includes: total duration estimate (words/180 = minutes), opening hook (10 words max), 5-7 key talking points (2 min each), visual direction notes (e.g., 'Show live demo of X for 30 sec'), closing summary (1 sentence), reference links
Validates that all 20 CoCu files have corresponding script templates, totaling approximately 200-300 hours of video content at standard production pace
